turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and when?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
You didn't answer me. Before you walk me through anything, tell me whether Owen was heard before that mark went in.
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.

11:31 PM, I'm writing that down. A file created that night says nothing about when he wrote the words, kids paste their work into new documents all the time. And none of it answers who decided on the zero, because procedure 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody called me.
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
11:52, 612, 11:58, 794. Turn the screen, Hale, I read documents myself. And you still haven't told me who decided on that zero.
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Don't manage me. Is that document coming my way, or am I going upstairs?
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.

"Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings." I'm writing that down, word for word, and I'll check it against the play myself tonight. Students misremember lines all the time, Hale, so a misquote makes him careless, not dishonest.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Save it, Hale. Answer the misquote or show me the screen.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.

October 15, cowardice, then moral caution, I've got it. Changing his mind between an outline and a final draft is what you teach them to do, Hale. Is that outline in this room, with his name and that date on it?
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag saying its indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. Procedure 4.3 says the same thing. You were doing better with paper, Hale, so show me the paper.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
There's no off the record, Hale, and you're asking me how to do your job. Withdraw the zero, or put those documents in front of me.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.

That's procedure 4.4, and its mark replaces the zero, Hale, not sits next to it. Nothing on his record, private, not in front of his class, and all of it in an email tonight. I haven't agreed to any rewrite yet, so you still owe me the outline and that document history on a screen I can read.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? I'm not the one being questioned, Hale, and that's ten minutes gone. The outline and the document history, on the screen, now.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.

Go ahead, I'm going to the principal's office tonight anyway, and under 4.6 I'll take it to the board after that. Put "the zero stands" in writing, with who decided it and when. You've told me about documents for ten minutes, Hale, and shown me none of them.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither, Hale: the zero comes off. Show me that document history and the outline, and then we can talk about 4.4, in writing, private, nothing on his record.
